summary.en: Up to three numbers land a beat apart over a rule made of the same squares; the protagonist number is larger in the accent and its own squares wait under it as beads that light up one by one on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 最多三个数字隔一拍落定，下面是同一批方块排成的一条线；主角数字更大、用强调色，它自己的方块在下面排成珠子，最后一个强拍上逐颗亮起。

fits: The lock-up of a counted film: the whole, one notable count, the protagonist.
notFor: More than three numbers; three equal numbers (one must be the protagonist).

intent.en: The film ends on the few numbers that matter, standing on a rule made of the same squares, the protagonist last and largest.
intent.zh: 全片收在几个要紧的数字上，它们站在同一批方块排成的尺上，主角最后出现、最大。

content.en: Up to three numbers (value, label ≤ 24 / 10 字), the protagonist index; optional source line.
content.zh: 最多三个数字（数值，标签 ≤ 24 字符 / 10 字），主角序号；可选来源一行。

fits.zh: 计数片的落版：整体、一个值得注意的计数、主角。

notFor.zh: 超过三个数字；三个一样分量的数字（必须有一个是主角）。

pairs.note: its second move on the last downbeat

en: Let the protagonist number be the only accent on screen.
zh: 主角数字是屏上唯一的强调色。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
